name: Paycom
description: Paycom is a single-database HCM platform covering payroll, talent acquisition, talent management, HR management, and time and labor management, built around Beti, an employee-driven payroll tool where employees review and fix their own paycheck data before each run.
best_for: Mid-sized to large employers wanting a single-database HCM suite with employee-driven payroll verification rather than an admin-only payroll process.
features: Beti, an employee-driven payroll tool that has employees review and fix their own hours, expenses, and deductions before payroll is submitted
Single-database architecture spanning payroll, HR, talent acquisition, talent management, and time/labor management
Employee Self-Service for employees to manage their own HR functions
Manager-on-the-Go mobile tools for approvals and management tasks
IWant, a command-driven search tool for accessing HR and payroll data
Core vs. Complete package tiers across each solution category (Payroll, Talent Acquisition, Time and Labor, Talent Management, HR Management)
pros: Single shared database across payroll, HR, talent, and time modules, rather than separately synced systems
Beti shifts payroll error-checking to employees before submission instead of leaving it entirely to payroll admins
Ongoing support from a dedicated specialist is included in the quoted price at no extra cost
cons: No pricing is published on paycom.com; every quote is customized to workforce size and selected tools after contacting sales
Paycom's own pricing page states a one-time implementation fee is included in every quote, adding to first-year cost

tiers.name: Core
tiers.notes: Baseline functionality across Payroll, Talent Acquisition, Time and Labor Management, Talent Management, and HR Management. No published price; requires a custom quote.

tiers.name: Complete
tiers.notes: Expanded functionality across the same five solution categories. No published price; requires a custom quote.

alternatives.name: ADP Workforce Now
alternatives.description: ADP's HCM suite for small to midsized businesses, combining payroll, HR, time, and talent management.
alternatives.best_for: Employers wanting an established payroll bureau model rather than employee-driven payroll verification.

alternatives.name: Paylocity
alternatives.description: A cloud HCM platform covering payroll, HR, talent, and workforce management, aimed at mid-sized organizations.
alternatives.best_for: Mid-sized employers comparing single-vendor HCM suites with similar breadth to Paycom.

alternatives.name: Workday HCM
alternatives.description: An enterprise cloud HCM and finance suite used by large, complex organizations.
alternatives.best_for: Large enterprises needing global HCM depth beyond what a single-database SMB/mid-market platform like Paycom offers.
